name: Apple TV
install_hint: Install it in Settings → Supported TVs (or: pipx install pyatv).
works: Apple TV HD and Apple TV 4K with tvOS 15 or later, through the Companion protocol (pyatv). Tested on Apple TV 4K (3rd generation).
Navigation, OK, Back (Menu), Home, Play/Pause, volume, power and opening apps.
does_not_work: Apple TV 3rd generation and older (no Companion protocol).
Volume level and now-playing info are not shown: the remote only sends volume steps.
notes: Uses pyatv: from pipx (pipx install pyatv) if present, otherwise the app installs it into its own folder. Credentials live in ~/.pyatv.conf, shared with the atvremote CLI.
Volume keys work when the Apple TV controls the volume (HDMI-CEC to the TV, or HomePods).
Connecting to a sleeping Apple TV takes about 5 seconds; an awake one answers at once.
Typing (K) needs a selected text field on the Apple TV (search, login). There is no Return key over this protocol; search updates as you type.
